name: Harriet Josephine Adams (Gill)
notable_stories: Often referred to in records as Jacobina, she provided a home for her widowed mother Elizabeth in Ohio
Acted as the anchor for the missing Ohio branch of the Adams family
Outlived almost all of her siblings
milestones: Buried with Stephen Gill at Cedar Hill Cemetery
locations: Cedar Hill Cemetery, Newark, Licking County, Ohio
sources: Further Research on the Family and Descendants of Joseph P. and Elizabeth (Hamilton) Adams, William W. Allen (February 2012)
notes: Siblings listed: George Francis #1, Alexander Washington, Magdalena, Mary, Susan, and Ursula
Apparently outlived all her siblings, living past eighty [Bill Allen, Further Research, 2012, line 8535]
